items.ask: Overdue invoices now get a fee after thirty days on every plan; should the free plan be exempt?
items.why: Free plan customers would be charged for the first time, without notice.

items.ask: Unused credits now expire after six months instead of twelve; do current balances keep the old date?
items.why: Customers who bought credits last year could lose them without warning.

items.ask: A plan change now takes its new price at the next renewal; does a downgrade refund the difference?
items.why: Customers who downgrade mid-cycle would pay the old price until renewal.
